STRIKE_HEXER.title: Strike
DEFEND_HEXER.title: Defend
CURSE_ZHOU.title: Hex: Frailness
CURSE_ZU.title: Hex: Exposure
CURSE_YUAN.title: Hex: Grudge
CURSE_YUAN.description: When drawn, ALL units gain 3 [gold]Thorns[/gold] this turn.
EPHEMERAL_HEX.title: Ephemeral Hex
SPIRIT_SLASH.title: Spirit Slash
SOUL_WARD.title: Soul Ward
GRUDGE_PULSE.title: Grudge Pulse
GRUDGE_PULSE.description: Draw {Cards:diff()} cards. If any [gold]Curse[/gold] is drawn, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
SHADOW_WHISPER.title: Shadow Whisper
SHADOW_WHISPER.description: Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] and {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL enemies. Gain {PsychokinesisPower:diff()} [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold].
EXORCISE_STRIKE.title: Exorcising Strike
WRAITH_TALISMAN.title: Wraith Talisman
MIND_NEEDLE.title: Mind Needle
SWEEPING_HEX.title: Sweeping Hex
SWEEPING_HEX.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies.
CURSED_SCYTHE.title: Cursed Scythe
CURSED_SCYTHE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Put {Cards:diff()} [gold]Ephemeral Hex[/gold] into your discard pile.
BLIND_THRUST.title: Blind Thrust
BLIND_THRUST.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the target has [gold]Grudge[/gold], draw {Cards:diff()} card(s).
SOUL_DRAIN_STRIKE.title: Soul Drain Strike
TRIPLE_NEEDLE.title: Triple Needle
TRIPLE_NEEDLE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy {Hits} times. Randomly [gold]Exhaust[/gold] 1 [gold]Curse[/gold] in your hand; if you do, gain {PsychokinesisPower:diff()} [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold].
HEXED_IRON_WAVE.title: Hexed Iron Wave
HEXED_IRON_WAVE.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Put 1 [gold]Ephemeral Hex[/gold] into your discard pile.
GRUDGE_LASH.title: Grudge Lash
EXORCISING_ARC.title: Exorcising Arc
BLIND_STEP.title: Blind Step
HEXBRAND.title: Hexbrand
MIRE_SHROUD.title: Mire Shroud
WHISPERING_PRAYER.title: Whispering Prayer
WHISPERING_PRAYER.description: [gold]Blessing {Blessing:diff()}[/gold] on an ally and grant them {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
DRAW_THE_OMEN.title: Draw the Omen
DRAW_THE_OMEN.description: Place up to {Omen:diff()} [gold]Curse[/gold] card(s) on top of your draw pile, then draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
BURN_THE_TALISMAN.title: Burn the Talisman
BURN_THE_TALISMAN.description: [gold]Exhaust[/gold] 1 card from your hand and gain {PsychokinesisPower:diff()} [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold]. If it was a [gold]Curse[/gold], gain 1 Energy and draw 1 card.
CALM_MIND.title: Calm Mind
CALM_MIND.description: Draw {Cards:diff()} cards. Put 1 [gold]Ephemeral Hex[/gold] into your discard pile.
GRUDGE_RESONANCE.title: Grudge Resonance
GRUDGE_RESONANCE.description: Deal {CalculationBase:diff()} damage. Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each stack of [gold]Grudge[/gold] on the target.
PURIFYING_PRAYER.title: Purifying Prayer
PURIFYING_PRAYER.description: [gold]Blessing {Blessing:diff()}[/gold] on an ally, then heal them for {Heal:diff()} HP.
CURSED_BARRIER.title: Cursed Barrier
CURSED_BARRIER.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Deal damage equal to your current [gold]Block[/gold] to a random enemy.
MIND_OVERLOAD.title: Mind Overload
MIND_OVERLOAD.description: Your [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold] cost per empowered card is fixed at 1 (empowerment bonus still equals half your Psychokinesis, rounded up).
PSYCHIC_BARRAGE.title: Psychic Barrage
PSYCHIC_BARRAGE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage X times. Gain X [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold].
CONTAGIOUS_MALICE.title: Contagious Malice
CONTAGIOUS_MALICE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Copy the target's [gold]Weak[/gold] and [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to all other enemies.
THORNY_EMBRACE.title: Thorny Embrace
PHANTOM_FLURRY.title: Phantom Flurry
PHANTOM_FLURRY.description: [gold]Exhaust[/gold] ALL [gold]Curses[/gold] in your hand. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Hits} times, plus 1 additional time for each card exhausted.
SEVERING_EXORCISM.title: Severing Exorcism
SEVERING_EXORCISM.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. [gold]Exorcise {Exorcise:diff()}[/gold]. Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] per stack of [gold]Grudge[/gold] cleansed.
ABYSSAL_LANCE.title: Abyssal Lance
ABYSSAL_LANCE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage (attack twice if the target has more than 5 [gold]Grudge[/gold]). Apply {ShrinkPower:diff()} [gold]Shrink[/gold].
LEECHING_HEX.title: Leeching Hex
LEECHING_HEX.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Heal {Heal:diff()} HP for each stack of [gold]Grudge[/gold] on the target (up to 5).
SHATTERED_VISOR_STRIKE.title: Shattered Visor Strike
RESONANT_WAVE.title: Resonant Wave
RESONANT_WAVE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies {Hits} times.
VENGEFUL_COUNTER.title: Vengeful Counter
VENGEFUL_COUNTER.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] for each stack of [gold]Grudge[/gold] on you.
BLOOD_OFFERING_TALISMAN.title: Blood Offering Talisman
MIRROR_OF_MISFORTUNE.title: Mirror of Misfortune
MIRROR_OF_MISFORTUNE.description: Gain 1 [gold]Vulnerable[/gold]. Copy all of your [gold]Grudge[/gold] (Weak, Frail, Shrink, Vulnerable) onto the target, then [gold]Blessing {Blessing:diff()}[/gold] on yourself.
CURSE_WEAVING.title: Curse Weaving
CURSE_WEAVING.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Add {Cards:diff()} [gold]Ephemeral Hex[/gold] to your hand.
LAYERED_BARRIER.title: Layered Barrier
LAYERED_BARRIER.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Exhaust[/gold] ALL [gold]Curses[/gold] in your hand; gain {BonusBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] and {PsychokinesisPower:diff()} [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold] for each.
DEEP_MEDITATION.title: Deep Meditation
CONDENSED_WILL.title: Condensed Will
CONDENSED_WILL.description: This turn, empowering Attacks, Block, or Heal does not spend [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold].
RITUAL_OF_BURDENS.title: Ritual of Burdens
RITUAL_OF_BURDENS.description: Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] and {FrailPower:diff()} [gold]Frail[/gold] to ALL units. Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] and draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
SOUL_CLEANSING.title: Soul Cleansing
SOUL_CLEANSING.description: Heal {Heal:diff()} HP, plus 2 HP for each [gold]Curse[/gold] in your hand.
HEX_TRANSFER.title: Hex Transfer
HEX_TRANSFER.description: Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] and {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold]. Add 1 [gold]Ephemeral Hex[/gold] to your hand.
GRAVEYARD_ECHO.title: Graveyard Echo
GRAVEYARD_ECHO.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Return up to {Cards:diff()} random [gold]Curse[/gold] cards from your Exhaust pile to your hand.
SHARED_BURDEN.title: Shared Burden
SHARED_BURDEN.description: Cleanse up to {Cleanse:diff()} [gold]Grudge[/gold] stacks from an ally. Gain 2 [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold] and {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] per stack cleansed.
CHORUS_OF_BLESSINGS.title: Chorus of Blessings
CHORUS_OF_BLESSINGS.description: [gold]Blessing {Blessing:diff()}[/gold] on ALL allies and grant them {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
ECHOING_BELLS.title: Echoing Bells
ECHOING_BELLS.description: Whenever a [gold]Curse[/gold] or [gold]Ethereal[/gold] card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold], gain {EchoingBellsPower:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] and deal that much damage to ALL enemies.
GRUDGE_SIPHON.title: Grudge Siphon
GRUDGE_SIPHON.description: Whenever you apply [gold]Grudge[/gold] to an enemy, deal {GrudgeSiphonPower:diff()} damage to it.
CURSED_SANCTUARY.title: Cursed Sanctuary
CURSED_SANCTUARY.description: At the start of your turn, add 1 [gold]Ephemeral Hex[/gold] to your hand and gain {CursedSanctuaryPower:diff()} [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold].
OBSIDIAN_AEGIS.title: Obsidian Aegis
PAINFUL_ATTUNEMENT.title: Painful Attunement
HEX_LINK.title: Hex Link
HEX_LINK.description: Whenever an ally deals damage to an enemy, gain {HexLinkPower:diff()} [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold].
ABYSSAL_GAZE.title: Abyssal Gaze
ABYSSAL_GAZE.description: Enemies with more than 5 total stacks of [gold]Weak[/gold] and [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] have their Weak and Vulnerable effects doubled.
GREAT_EXORCISM.title: Great Exorcism
TEN_THOUSAND_GRUDGES.title: Ten Thousand Grudges
TEN_THOUSAND_GRUDGES.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Hits} times. Attack 1 additional time for each stack of [gold]Grudge[/gold] on you and the target.
PSYCHOKINETIC_CATACLYSM.title: Psychokinetic Cataclysm
PSYCHOKINETIC_CATACLYSM.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Remove all [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold] to deal {Extra:diff()} additional damage per stack to ALL enemies.
KARMIC_SEVERANCE.title: Karmic Severance
KARMIC_SEVERANCE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. [gold]Exorcise {Exorcise:diff()}[/gold]. Deal {BonusDmg:diff()} additional damage per stack of [gold]Grudge[/gold] cleansed.
SOUL_REAPER_SCYTHE.title: Soul Reaper Scythe
SOUL_REAPER_SCYTHE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Heal {Heal:diff()} HP for each enemy with [gold]Grudge[/gold].
CURSED_SINGULARITY.title: Cursed Singularity
CURSED_SINGULARITY.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Attack 1 additional time for each [gold]Curse[/gold] in your Hand, Draw, Discard, and Exhaust piles.
FORBIDDEN_RITE.title: Forbidden Rite
FORBIDDEN_RITE.description: Gain 2 [gold]Vulnerable[/gold]. Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}, draw {Cards:diff()} cards, and gain {PsychokinesisPower:diff()} [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold].
AWAKEN_THE_THREE_CURSES.title: Awaken the Three Curses
AWAKEN_THE_THREE_CURSES.description: [gold]Upgrade[/gold] all copies of your 3 starter Curses and place them on top of your draw pile. Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
ETERNAL_SHROUD.title: Eternal Shroud
ETERNAL_SHROUD.description: Gain 1 [gold]Intangible[/gold] and {PsychokinesisPower:diff()} [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold]. Shuffle 2 [gold]Ephemeral Hex[/gold] into your draw pile.
TRANSMUTE_MALICE.title: Transmute Malice
SANCTUARY_OF_SOULS.title: Sanctuary of Souls
SANCTUARY_OF_SOULS.description: [gold]Blessing {Blessing:diff()}[/gold] on ALL allies, grant them 1 [gold]Buffer[/gold], and heal them for {Heal:diff()} HP.
BLIND_SEER_FORM.title: Blind Seer Form
BLIND_SEER_FORM.description: At the start of your turn, apply 1 [gold]Weak[/gold] and 1 [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL units, and gain 3 [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold].
UNENDING_GRUDGE.title: Unending Grudge
UNENDING_GRUDGE.description: Whenever you cleanse a stack of [gold]Grudge[/gold] via [gold]Exorcise[/gold] or [gold]Blessing[/gold], gain 2 [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold] and 2 [gold]Block[/gold].
VESSEL_OF_CURSES.title: Vessel of Curses
VESSEL_OF_CURSES.description: Whenever you draw a [gold]Curse[/gold], gain {VesselOfCursesPower:diff()} [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold] and draw 1 card.
ASCENDANT_MEDIUM.title: Ascendant Medium
ASCENDANT_MEDIUM.description: Whenever you spend [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold] on an Attack, gain {AscendantMediumPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold]; on a Skill, gain {AscendantMediumPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
